info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Status API provides real-time information on the status of logistics shipments. This endpoint allows consumers to monitor the progress and performance of their shipments, ensuring efficient logistics management. Typical use cases include supply chain managers and logistics coordinators checking shipment statuses to optimize deliveries and resolve issues promptly. The API offers detailed status updates, facilitating better decision-making and enhancing communication with stakeholders.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of your shipments. You can use it to check delivery progress, delays, or other relevant updates pertaining to your shipments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of shipments. It contains the necessary parameters to specify the shipments for which the status is requested.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
